summary: Chargebee provides a comprehensive subscription management and billing solution with capabilities including usage-based pricing, customer retention, and revenue recognition. With 60+ integrations and 30+ payment gateways, it allows businesses to launch subscription models, experiment with pricing, and serve customers worldwide.

ThoughtSpot offers an Agentic Analytics platform, named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant, that empowers users with AI-driven insights. The platform includes multiple features such as Spotter, an autonomous AI agent, and Analyst Studio, a space for data teams to accelerate insights, among others. It aims to democratize data, enabling anyone to derive actionable intelligence from it.
